deviations.what: t2 also added the pgvector service and test DSN to the visual and ragas CI jobs, and added psycopg[binary] to the dev dependency group
deviations.reason: both jobs run pytest and load the root conftest, so without a database they would fail at session start; no driver was installed for the fixture before t1 adds the pg extra

deviations.what: deploy restart starts postgres in its own step (up -d --no-deps --wait postgres) before the library and mcp step, instead of dropping --no-deps or adding postgres to SERVICES; mcp gets no database credentials
deviations.reason: --wait blocks until postgres is healthy so the order is explicit in dry-run, and mcp reaches the library only over HTTP, so least privilege leaves it without database credentials

deviations.what: t1 also edited core/__init__.py (dropped side-effect imports of unported modules and the SCHEMA/register_schema exports), put the items table in 0001_initial.sql for t4 to extend, fixed a temp-name collision in Store.write_blob, and deleted tests/core/test_store.py and test_store_migration.py (moving two kind tests to test_todo_kind.py)
deviations.reason: without the __init__ edit no core module imports at all; t4's criterion names 0001_initial.sql as the single initial schema; the concurrent-add test exposed the write_blob race; the deleted tests covered the SQLite store and the kind-CHECK rebuild that no longer exist

deviations.what: t4 added culture_library/core/embedding_strategy.py (the canonical strategy key, model id and HNSW index name and SQL), a CHECK that each vector's dimension equals its strategy's, and named the chunker paragraph-pack
deviations.reason: one producer of the strategy key keeps index predicates and queries matching exactly; the CHECK stops a vector of the wrong size reaching a typed HNSW index

deviations.what: keys._live selects the old key row FOR UPDATE, so a rotate or confirm cannot race another one
deviations.reason: under Postgres concurrency two rotations of one key could both read it live and both mint replacements; SQLite's single writer prevented that

deviations.what: t5's library tests were verified only against scratch stand-ins for feed, indexer, search and repodocs, because library.py imports indexer and search (plan waves 3-4); t5 also dropped the item_uploaders backfill (t14 copies the rows) and added library.lock_blob, which every blob writer must take
deviations.reason: the plan put t5 in wave 2, but library.py cannot import until t12/t13 port search and indexer; the backfill only served SQLite databases that predate item_uploaders

deviations.what: t10 left /api/health (server/app.py, outside its files) unchanged; the main agent added the database check there: SELECT 1 through the store, 503 with status error when the database is unreachable, body unchanged when it answers. t10 also ported core/sources.py, which t5 owns; t5's version was kept at merge
deviations.reason: criterion 1 needs /api/health to fail with the database stopped, and app.py belonged to no wave-2 task; the duplicate sources.py port conflicted with t5's

deviations.what: t12: hybrid passages fuse over a pool (per corpus the nearest max(2k,50) chunks plus the nearest k chunks of each of the top max(2k,50) full-text matches) instead of every chunk; zero vectors are refused at write; pack_vec, unpack_vec and cosine_scorer are removed; set_repodoc_text indexes the title plus the words of the path; 22 indexer tests are parked with skip markers until t13
deviations.reason: scanning every chunk defeats the HNSW index; pgvector's cosine HNSW index cannot find zero vectors; the helpers only served the removed Python scorer; Postgres keeps a path as one token; the indexer is ported in t13

deviations.what: t13 edited server/routes_search.py (removed the label-based requeue_stale_model call; the indexer requeues stale (model, strategy) itself), padded fake embedders in waiting-list tests to 768 dimensions, moved test_review_fixes test 8 to the (model id, strategy) API, and fixed r5 by adding a vector of only the punctuation-containing tokens split on [[:punct:]] instead of concatenating split text
deviations.reason: a label passed as a model id would reopen the whole corpus each start; t12 requires 768-d vectors; the label column is gone; full concatenation changed every tsvector and ts_delete broke underscore phrases

deviations.what: t16 (SQLite-free sweep) starts in parallel with t14 instead of after it, limited to files outside culture_library/migrate/ and tests/migrate/; its full-suite criterion is checked after t14 merges
deviations.reason: the 31 remaining failures outside migrate/ (old 2-d fakes, leftover sqlite3 tests, routes using a fixed vector pair, the pg extra) touch no t14 file, so running them together shortens the critical path without file overlap

deviations.what: t16 is built by an opus subagent instead of the main agent named in the split plan; the main agent keeps the final full-suite verification and merge
deviations.reason: the main agent's context is long after waves 0-4; the sweep is a bounded, file-listed task with a grep test and a known failure list, so delegating it keeps the integration check with the main agent

deviations.what: t14 added --drop-stale-vectors and --verify-only, sets identities to max(max id, sqlite_sequence), drops the HNSW indexes for the copy and rebuilds them serially (maintenance_work_mem 1GB, no parallel workers), lets the xteink dry run open Store(dest) (applies migrations, creates dest/files), and imports two private store helpers
deviations.reason: stale labels must be skippable rather than block cutover; SQLite AUTOINCREMENT never reuses ids, so neither may Postgres; inserting 70k distinct vectors with the index in place took over 215 s, and a parallel build exhausted Docker's 64 MB shared memory

deviations.what: Main-agent integration after t14 and t16: (1) the per-test reset in tests/conftest.py now drops any public index a test created, so an HNSW index for a new (model, strategy) pair no longer leaks into later tests; (2) search._ann completes a group of exactly tied chunks the pool LIMIT cut (fetch limit+1; on a tie at the edge, score that distance exactly), so ties break on (owner, chunk_no) and every k is a prefix of a larger k
deviations.reason: both caused intermittent full-suite failures; the tie case is real on live, where many repo docs are byte-identical (.devague/current), and SQLite's exhaustive scan always ordered ties the same way

deviations.what: t17 documents the live backup timer and the cutover copy as 'grant run ... docker compose run --rm --no-deps -v <dir>:/backup library culture-library ...' instead of 'docker exec', and trimmed QWEN.md to stay under its 145-line cap
deviations.reason: compose mounts no backup directory into the library container, so a docker exec backup would have nowhere to write; test_harness_files_stay_in_step enforces the QWEN.md cap

deviations.what: Ship 0.20.1 before the cutover: the copy knows 0.19.8's vector_log (the vector cache's change log, derived state Postgres has no use for) and skips it, naming it and its row count in the report; the source fixture gains vector_log and its triggers so the tests use the real 0.19.8 schema. t19 runs on 0.20.1.
deviations.reason: The t18 drill's copy of the real live library.db refused it (unknown vector_log); the cutover cannot run on 0.20.0.

deviations.what: 0.20.1 also changes backup restore: it leaves the dump's EXTENSION and COMMENT ON EXTENSION entries out (via a filtered pg_restore --use-list), requires the target to already have the vector extension (created by the superuser, as the init script does), and refuses up front with that remediation when it is missing. backup.md says how to make the restore target.
deviations.reason: The t18 drill's restore as the app role failed on the dump's extension entries; a live restore would fail the same way.

deviations.what: Correction to d16's mechanism: restore passes pg_restore --no-comments instead of a filtered --use-list. The rest of d16 stands (vector extension required up front, refused with the superuser remediation, backup.md updated).
deviations.reason: Smaller than the TOC filter d16 named: the dump's only COMMENT is the extension's, and its CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS is a no-op for a non-owner once the extension exists; a --use-list file would also not reach the test suite's docker-exec pg_restore wrapper.

deviations.what: 0.20.1 also narrows d13's tie completion to chunks whose text equals a tied chunk's text before scoring them, instead of rescoring the whole corpus. Identical vectors come from identical text under one (model, strategy); a different-text chunk at exactly the same float distance is no longer pulled in, which the code comment states.
deviations.reason: Measured on the t18 scratch copy of live data: combined search p95 546 ms against the < 500 ms success signal; the slow statement (about 260 ms, 5 of 40 queries) is d13's tie completion, which scores all 62,591 repo-doc vectors whenever the pool edge falls in a group of identical vectors (the same file pushed from many repos). Narrowing by chunk text first costs about 11 ms.
